ctx.x: I want to correct something here. I mentioned the man who now owns a great deal of Central Avenue and his father apparently owned a great deal of it in his Bluestone; it wasn't, it's Bluestein. I don't believe it heyday. I thought his name was (inaudible) Stein. (Inaudible) Bluestein Property Company Section who runs the Blue Star (inaudible) and owns most of the Second of and Central Avenue, around the Dunbar at this point. Wanted to get that into the record. (Inaudible).

Well, he probably owns quite a bit of the commercial property on Central Avenue itself. Most of the houses on the side streets are still owned by families that have been there for 20, 30, 40, 50 years.
